title: The Will of the Many
author: James Islington
summary: Vis, an orphan from a conquered land, is adopted into a powerful family of a Roman-flavoured republic where citizens lend their strength to those above them. To climb, he enters a harsh academy where students are ranked and tested against each other.
readIf: you like fantasy with a school setting, ranked competitions and plenty of political scheming.
skipIf: you want a short book or a story that wraps up without a sequel.

pairings.reason: Also drops an outsider into a brutal, ranked academy inside a rigid class system, with a faster, more violent edge.
Another long fantasy built around a gifted young person at a school, with a more lyrical and personal voice.
Same author, earlier and more traditional: a school for gifted youths, hidden powers and a long, layered mystery.
